granola_api_key.title: GRANOLA_API_KEY
granola_api_key.description: Granola public API key, created in Granola desktop under Settings → Connectors → API keys. Creating one requires a Business or Enterprise Granola workspace; personal and free workspaces cannot issue keys. Needed to fetch new meeting data; reading data already synced into the local store needs no key.
